[Help, legend, allergy info, consults, alternative antimicrobials and more \(Inpt\)](general-information-inpatient)

# TOXOPLASMA SPP.

If patient is immunocompetent and not pregnant, treatment is usually not needed

as disease is usually self-limited. Patients who are immunocompromised, pregnant

or have severe disease should be treated. Consult Infectious Diseases in all

cases.

# _______________________________________________________________________________

# Non-pregnant patients

# _______________________________________________________________________________

# Duration of antimicrobial therapy

Treat immunocompetent patients for 2-4 weeks. Treat immunocompromised patients

for 6 weeks or longer if radiologic disease is extensive or response is

incomplete at 6 weeks.

# Preferred treatment

Patients weighing <60 kg

[Pyrimethamine 200 mg PO once \($$$\), then 50 mg PO q24h \($$\) DI,O <AND>](orz-set-abx-pyrim200mgthen50mgq24h-sulfdiaz1gmq6h-leuco10mgq24h)

sulfadiazine 1 gm PO q6h ($$) [DI,O] <AND> leucovorin 10-25 mg PO q24h($) [M]

Patients weighing >60kg

[Pyrimethamine 200 mg PO once \($$$\), then 75 mg PO q24h \($$\) DI,O <AND>](orz-set-abx-pyrim200mgthen75mgq24h-sulfad1-5gmq6h-leuco10mgq24h)

sulfadiazine 1.5 gm PO q6h ($$) [DI,O] <AND> leucovorin 10-25 mg PO q24h($) [M]

# Preferred alternative for sulfa allergy

Patients weighing <60 kg

[Pyrimethamine 200 mg PO once \($$$\), then 50 mg PO q24h \($$\) DI,O <AND>](orz-set-abx-pyrim200mgthen50mgq24h-clinda600mgq6h-leuco10mgq24h)

clindamycin 600 mg PO q6h ($) [H,O] <AND> leucovorin 10-25 mg PO q24h ($) [M]

Patients weighing >60 kg

[Pyrimethamine 200 mg PO once \($$$\), then 75 mg PO q24h \($$\) DI,O <AND>](orz-set-abx-pyrim200mgthen75mgq24h-clinda600mgq6h-leuco10mgq24h)

clindamycin 600 mg PO q6h ($) [H,O] <AND> leucovorin 10-25 mg PO q24h ($) [M]

# Secondary alternatives

[Trimethoprim 5 mg/kg-sulfamethoxazole 25 mg/kg IV q12h \($$\) R,DI](psjizid-trimethoprim-sulfameth-5-25-mg-kg-iv-q12h)

< OR >

[Trimethoprim 5 mg/kg-sulfamethoxazole 25 mg/kg PO q12h \($\) R,DI](psjzid-trimeth-sulfa-5-25-mg-kg-po-q12h)

# _______________________________________________________________________________

# Chronic Maintenance therapy for immunocompromised patients

# _______________________________________________________________________________

Discontinue maintenance therapy if patient has remained asymptomatic and CD4 >

200 cells per microliter.

# Maintenance therapy

[Pyrimethamine 50 mg PO q24h \($$\) DI,O <AND> sulfadiazine 0.5-1 gm PO q6h](orz-set-abx-pyrim-50mg-q24h-sulfadiaz-0-5gm-q6h-leuco-10mg-q24h)

($$) <AND> leucovorin 10-25 mg PO q24h ($) [M]

# Preferred alternative for sulfa allergy

[Pyrimethamine 50 mg PO q24h \($$\) DI,O <AND> clindamycin 600 mg PO q8h \($\)](orz-set-abx-pyrim-50mg-q24h-clinda-600mg-q8h-leuco-10mg-q24h)

[H,O] <AND> leucovorin 10-25 mg PO q24h ($) [M]

# Secondary alternatives

[Pyrimethamine 25 mg PO q24h \($$\) DI,O <AND> atovaquone 750-1500 mg PO](orz-set-abx-pyrime-25mg-q24h-atova-750mg-q12h-leuco-10mg-q24h)

q12h ($) [M] <AND> leucovorin 10-25 mg PO q24h ($) [M]

< OR >

[Trimethoprim sulfamethoxazole 1DS tablet PO q24h \($\) R,DI](psjzid-trimeth-sulfa-1-ds-tablet-po-q24h)

< OR >

[Atovaquone 750-1500 mg PO q12h \($\) M](psjzid-atovaquone-750mg-po-q12h)

# _______________________________________________________________________________

# Pregnant patients

# _______________________________________________________________________________

# Patient diagnosed <16-18 weeks of gestation

*Contact Infectious Diseases, non-formulary consult is required for spiramycin

Spiramycin 1 gm po q8h until week 18 of gestation

# Patient diagnosed >16-18 weeks of gestation

[Pyrimethamine 50 mg q12h for 2 days, then 50 mg PO q24h \($$\) DI,O <AND>](orz-set-abx-pyrimethamine-sulfadiazine-leucovorin-pregnancy)

sulfadiazine 75mg/kg once, then 50mg/kg q12h ($$) [DI,O] <AND> leucovorin 10-25

mg PO q24h ($) [M] for 4 weeks or duration of pregnancy if ultrasound evidence

of fetal distress

References:

Guidelines for Prevention and Treatment of Opportunistic Infections in HIV

Infected Adults and Adolescents. AIDSinfo (2015) 1-282

Mandell chapter: Toxoplasma gondii

Sanford keyword: Toxoplasmosis

Up-to-Date article: Toxoplasmosis in immunocompetent hosts
